name: jolt-j3-backend-core
title: Jolt J3: JoltBackend core behind IPhysicsBackend (bodies, compound shapes, mass, gravity, forces/velocities, enable/disable, kinematic/static moves, transform sync, deterministic ids and iteration) and the physics test suites as typed tests over both backends
issue: Physics investigation C:/Method Notes Obsidian/orchestrator/proposals/physics-backend-investigation-156.md (decisions P1-P11 ACCEPTED 2026-10-20; read sections 1, 2.1, 4.1-4.4 FULLY, the J3 row of 6.3, 7 risks). MERGED prerequisites: J1 #195 (Jolt v5.6.0 vendored in external/JoltPhysics, N2ENGINE_USE_JOLT, the Jolt::Jolt target built with CROSS_PLATFORM_DETERMINISTIC, smoke test, cmake/jolt), J2 #199 (IPhysicsBackend additions: DeterminismLevel GetDeterminism, SupportsSnapshot/SupportsSetState, BackendId, GetBodyState/SetBodyState (PhysX implemented), HashState optional, the physics.backend project setting with selection logic in Application::Init, health detail), A1/A2/C1? (C1 engine-owned trig may still be open: do not depend on it). Read the existing PhysX backend (engine/src/physics/physx/*, PhysXBackend.hpp/.cpp) as the behavioural reference, IPhysicsBackend.hpp, the Rigidbody/collider components, the physics tests (tests/engine/physics/PhysicsTests.cpp, LayerPhysicsTests.cpp, PhysicsOrderTests.cpp: they install a backend through Set3DPhysicsBackend), docs/physics.html and the J1/J2 sections. THIS ITEM IS J3 ONLY (core; layers/triggers/events are J4, queries J5, snapshot J6). SCOPE: (1) JoltBackend (engine/src/physics/jolt/*, behind N2ENGINE_USE_JOLT; compiled and tested on every leg that builds Jolt: linux, windows, arm64, web (single-threaded)) implementing the IPhysicsBackend core per section 4.3: body creation for Static/Dynamic/Kinematic, ONE compound shape per body with sub-shape user data = collider index (single collider at origin = plain shape), Sphere/Box/Capsule mapping (Box convex radius <= min half-extent, capsule axis convention converted), mass authoritative with inertia from non-trigger shapes (EOverrideMassProperties::CalculateInertia: verify the exact names in the vendored headers), gravity enabled flag via gravity factor, forces/velocities/impulses as the interface defines, body enable/disable (RemoveBody/AddBody keeping the id), kinematic moves via MoveKinematic and static moves via SetPositionAndRotation, TRANSFORM SYNC iterating the backend's own handle-ordered body list (NEVER GetActiveBodies: its order is nondeterministic [V Jolt docs]), BODY IDS via CreateBodyWithID following the engine's deterministic handle free list (so ids match across peers), fixed-step Update with collision steps 1 and the JobSystem choice: JobSystemSingleThreaded on web and whenever the Deterministic preset is active (until CI proves thread-count independence), JobSystemThreadPool otherwise (a project-visible constant), temp allocator sizing, the global init (RegisterDefaultAllocator, Factory, RegisterTypes) once per process with ref-counting so two backends in tests do not double-init, trigger/layer/event/query/snapshot members return documented 'not implemented yet' results (J4/J5/J6) with ONE warning and never crash; (2) DECLARATIONS: GetDeterminism = CrossPlatform ONLY IF the build defines JPH_CROSS_PLATFORM_DETERMINISTIC and the strict-FP profile holds per the design (otherwise SameBinary: follow section 4.2/5 exactly and record), SupportsSetState true/false per what you implement (implement Get/SetBodyState for Jolt if section 4.4 requires it for J3, else leave to J6 and say so), SupportsSnapshot false until J6, BackendId 'jolt'; (3) selection: physics.backend = jolt creates JoltBackend when compiled in (J2's selection logic; update the unavailable-backend message), and tests construct it directly; (4) TESTS: turn the existing physics conformance tests into TYPED TESTS over both backends where the tested behaviour is core (bodies, forces, gravity, kinematic/static, enable/disable, mass, transform sync, ordering): the suites for layers/triggers/events/queries stay PhysX-only until J4/J5 (mark them clearly); every behavioural DIFFERENCE found between PhysX and Jolt (friction model: one friction per body, no static friction; restitution; combine rule; sleeping; solver differences) is recorded in docs/physics.html as a table and in dev.json deviations (the USER must accept them); determinism smoke: the same scene stepped twice in one process gives identical state hashes, and the cross-leg state hash printed in CI (like J1's step: add a 'Jolt backend determinism numbers' step: if the hash differs between legs that is a REAL finding: report, do not loosen); (5) DOCS: docs/physics.html (the Jolt backend: what exists, mapping table, differences, how to select it, determinism declaration and its conditions), docs/testing.html, docs/application.html if the selection text changes. Nothing builds locally for the engine; CI (12 checks) is the test; expect fix rounds; re-read every edit twice (CMake/YAML/C++ syntax); NEVER run taskkill or kill other processes; verify every docs sentence against the CODE; no attribution lines on commits; GitHub only via the wrapper; your FINAL message must be a real report (PR number, head sha, what you did, deviations), never a single word.
acceptance: JoltBackend core implements bodies, compound shapes, mass, gravity, forces/velocities, enable/disable, kinematic/static moves, transform sync with deterministic ids and iteration; unimplemented members warn once
Core physics suites run as typed tests over PhysX and Jolt; behavioural differences documented and listed as deviations
Cross-leg state-hash step in CI; determinism declaration honest; web build single-threaded
notes: Reviewer: determinism hazards (iteration order, thread choice, ids, broadphase queries not used, FP flags), compound shape and mass mapping vs PhysX semantics, kinematic/static moves, enable/disable id stability, global init ref-counting, typed tests meaningful and behavioural differences complete and honestly documented, declaration honest (CrossPlatform only when the conditions hold), web single-thread path, docs true, mediums count.
